description: Two hooks. (1) PermissionRequest: carry an attention-store answer into a live permission prompt, so a manager can relay the operator's decision without the operator opening the worker's tab. Fail-open: an unanswered prompt stays for the human. Kill switch: SUPERVISOR_PERMISSION_POLL=off. (2) UserPromptSubmit / Stop / Notification: record what the session is doing, so the heartbeat timer can carry it onto the stamp the attention store reads. Fail-open: a missed write costs a stale state for up to one 30 s tick.
